links.outcome: Re-identification risk of pathological speech via automatic speaker verification, measured by equal error rate
links.effect: Pathological speech overall faces heightened re-identification risk vs healthy speech; adults with dysphonia at higher risk, dysarthria comparable to healthy; intelligibility did not affect ASV performance.
links.quote: Our comprehensive assessments demonstrate that pathological speech overall faces heightened privacy breach risks compared to healthy speech.

screen.reason: The study evaluates an automatic speaker verification (ASV) deep-learning model on pathological speech datasets to investigate patient re-identification and privacy risks.
